blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 76 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (October 21, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: DCBO & MRNA lead 76 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 26 Canadian and 50 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of October 21, 2026) found 76 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 26 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 11 of them new to the list this week. Docebo Inc. (DCBO) leads with a +74% six-month return, and Energy is the most represented sector with 12 names.

In the U.S., 50 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 34 of them new to the list this week. Moderna Inc. (MRNA) leads with a +384% six-month return, and Health Care is the most represented sector with 24 names.
